title: Football
info: Football, also called soccer, is played with a round ball and two goals.
Each team has 11 players. Only the goalkeeper may use hands, and only inside their own penalty area.
A goal counts when the whole ball crosses the goal line.

questions.q: How many players does one football team put on the field?

options: The goalkeeper, inside the penalty area
The whole ball crosses the goal line
